sasuke.directionNote: Original battle poses and action frames face right; left is mirrored. Vertical movement uses side poses because the original sheet has no up/down or walking rows.
sasuke.animationNote: Attack and Perform Jutsu are separate original four-frame rows. Shoot uses the original Perform Jutsu sequence; Charge retains that sequence for charge/channel animation. Hurt and Faint use their genuine three-frame rows.

chidori.sourceNote: Naruto: Path of the Ninja 2, Nintendo DS; Sasuke sheet ripped by Hwdphg. Three bottom-row Charging Chidori poses: one preparation pose and two original lightning poses. Dash reuses the genuine final forward-thrust Attack frame because this sheet has no Chidori running or up/down frames.
chidori.boundsNote: All three charge rects are exact connected foreground bounds, excluding the arrow and label. Anchors are crop-local character center/feet, aligned to source y=416 rather than the lower lightning edges. The dash hand is crop-local. Standard Charge/Shoot metadata is unchanged.

tenten.directionNote: Genuine front/back idle, walk and hurt views; left is mirrored from right. Side-only throws and death explicitly reuse right-facing poses for up/down.

pain.directionPolicy: right three-quarter; explicit horizontal mirror for left; same side pose for vertical travel
